lines.text: (An elegant old city spreads out before me, its atmosphere entirely different from the modern feel of Elias.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just as Ignate said, this looks like the former capital of a great empire. Grand and steeped in history.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But something about it feels unsettled. The people passing in the street have a strange anxiety on their faces...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who should I ask?)
(Just then, a rather roguish-looking young man passes in front of %s.)
Wow, great weather today. Right? Who am I even talking to? Well, it's perfect for a nap in the shade!
Tch. Nobody answers, and everyone's got a face like thunder. I can't stand it.
Xiaowei would've smiled and said something nice...
Cheer up, all of you!
Sigh. Would this place feel a little brighter if Xiaowei were here? Where on earth has she gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that the person Zoe and Muwen mentioned?)
Who are you? What gives you the right to throw her name around? That look on your face says you know something.

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: I'm Li Shangtsu. And who might you be? Out with it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain to Li Shangtsu that a friend asked me to pass on their regards to Xiaowei. His expression finally softens.)

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: You're with the people she mentioned. All right, I can trust you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where is Xiaowei...?

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: She disappears now and then, but she's been gone longer than usual this time. A lot of people are looking for her, so I've been searching too. Who knows when she'll turn up...

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: Want to help me look? I've tried all sorts of places, but there's one I haven't checked yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where's that?

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: The Red Crop Field, where the windmill stands. An old man shows up there sometimes. Someone saw her chatting with him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go and ask him.

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: All right. I'm counting on you.

steps.name: Seed of Calamity
steps.objective: Defeat [Pumpkins] in the "Red Crop Field" and obtain <Seeds of Calamity>. Then talk to [Zhongli Quan] in the "Red Crop Field".

lines.text: (An old man stands among the quiet Red Crop Field, looking troubled about something.)
Oh dear, this is bad. Very bad. How could I make a mistake like that...? What a nuisance.
Eh? Who are you?
(The old man in an oddly mysterious mask seems to notice my presence and looks this way.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, sir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I ask whether he is the old man who often chats with Xiaowei.)
Indeed. I believe I'm the old man that youngster mentioned. My name is Zhongli Quan. I often chat with our lady immortal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady immortal...?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Do you have a moment? I'd like you to help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: With what...?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Well, you see, I was riding my cloud over this land when I noticed an ominous energy gathering in the mountains and rivers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry? Riding a cloud?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Never seen a cloud-riding immortal before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, well...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: No need to concern yourself too much with that.
(A cloud with a mysterious air quietly drifts over and stops before Zhongli Quan.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Understand now? Anyway, I feared that sinister energy might cause a disaster, so I gathered it up and stuffed it into a pouch...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: But then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something went wrong.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Quick on the uptake! I'd like you to help me gather the Seeds of Calamity. They started thrashing about inside the pouch, then burst out in midair and fell down here...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: If those seeds sprout, there'll be a catastrophe. They might swallow this whole continent, starting with Yong Gyoung...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: And you'll never see the Xiaowei you're looking for.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: ...Forgive me for making such a shameless request. My old eyes aren't what they used to be...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: I'm only a low-ranking immortal, with so much work and stress that I'm forever coming down with something...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have a feeling I've gotten myself into trouble.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help you.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Really?! What a splendid person you are! With such an extraordinary aura, you'll find them in no time.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (Zhongli Quan eagerly clasps both of %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Please don't think me an utterly shameless immortal... Sob, sob. Anyway! Find the Seeds of Calamity nearby.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Once they start growing, they're practically monster feed...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hohoho... Sorry about all this. Bring them all back safely, and I'll tell you where Xiaowei went.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go find them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that a little smile behind his mask...? Or am I imagining it?)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (Hoho... This youngster is sharp.)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: You're remarkable.
(Zhongli Quan takes the Seeds of Calamity, then seems at a loss for words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Ah, my mind wandered for a moment. My apologies. That girl went into Shangri-La. Hurry, and you might catch her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. It was nice meeting you, sir.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Yes, take care. Oh, wait... I had something to tell you, but you're already gone.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: I meant to say that finding the way is difficult unless you're an immortal...

steps.name: Xiaowei, the Sword Blossom
steps.objective: 1. Find [Xiaowei] in "Shangri-La" in "Arcadia".\n2. Defeat monsters in "Shangri-La" to obtain <Ancient Ginseng>, then talk to [Zhongli Quan].

lines.text: (I follow a commotion deep inside Shangri-La and find a woman facing an enormous monster.)
(The monster looks ready to trample her at any moment, but she meets its gaze with a formidable presence of her own.)
Hyunmu, you who have strayed from the right path. As you are now, you cannot get past me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei?
(At the sound of %s's voice, the woman turns around in surprise.)
Who are you? How do you know me? Wait, I put up a barrier to keep everyone out. How did you...? No, that can wait.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: You there, get out of the way!!
(As Xiaowei speaks, the look in Hyunmu's eyes changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ngh... What is this...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hyunmu hasn't moved, but it feels as though it's coming right at me. My body is stiffening... It feels like something is binding me...)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Snap out of it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I'm dizzy...

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Look out!!
(The instant a strange energy surges out from Hyunmu, Xiaowei steps in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Aaah!
(Hyunmu's attack sends Xiaowei flying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-are you all right?!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I-I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help you too. It's still a little hard to move, but...

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Stay back! That monster is beyond anything you can handle!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But you got hurt because of me...
Well, well. Looks like things have gotten awkward.
(A woman's voice comes from somewhere nearby.)
You wicked turtle! Stay right there!!
(As the woman addresses Hyunmu, it backs away for a moment, seemingly flustered.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, the strange energy binding my body disappears, and I feel light again.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Ah, Master Yangso...
Now! Both of you! Over here!!

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Over here, Junior Sister Yangso!
Yes, yes. Yangso Lan Caihe isn't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Oh dear, Xiao's passed out. Look what happened to that pretty face...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Oh, it's you. You seem all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, sir...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: I'm glad you've still got the strength to talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... She saved us.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Yes, yes. Without an aura on the level of an immortal's, you could scarcely encounter Hyunmu, let alone escape.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then that means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The woman he called his junior sister must be an immortal too.)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Exactly what you're thinking. At any rate, Hyunmu doesn't seem inclined to follow us here. What do you think, Junior Sister?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Your formidable presence keeps the creature at bay, Senior Brother.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Kind of you to say so. Hohoho.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: That turtle seems to have some sense. It felt your aura and decided not to pursue us.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: You could have finished it off for me.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Surely you don't think a delicate woman like me enjoys fighting?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: R-right. Of course...

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Besides, the affairs of the mortal realm should be settled by mortals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't make heads or tails of these immortals' conversation...)
(As the immortals continue talking, Xiaowei regains consciousness and sits up.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Ah, Master Zhengyang. And Master Yangso...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei, are you awake?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yes, I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: You're awake? Not too badly hurt? Thank goodness for that.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Senior Brother, is that all you can do for a child you're so fond of? Xiao, let me see your face.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Oh my, scratches on that beautiful face! That turtle will pay!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Master Yangso, I'm fine. My lack of training has caused you needless worry.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: You've lost a lot of strength. Don't face opponents like that for a while.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I can't protect Yong Gyoung like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei, don't blame yourself.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Don't let this get you down. Oh dear, no tears now. Smile! You know what they say: good fortune comes to those who smile.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: I'll deal with that vile creature myself!!

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Senior Brother, however dear this aspiring sword immortal may be to us, we must not interfere.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Oh, forgive me for not introducing myself sooner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is... %s. Zoe and Muwen asked me to pass on their regards, so I came to Yong Gyoung...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly introduce myself and explain that the people of Yong Gyoung seem to be looking for Xiaowei.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I've worried so many people. Thank you for telling me. You have nothing to apologize for.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Young lady, you should rest. In this state, we'd feel bad even making our offer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An offer?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Miss Xiaowei comes from a distinguished family whose members have attained immortality. Her own potential is exceptional. Young as she is, her swordsmanship and diligence set an example for others.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: And her lovely voice, graceful dancing, and mastery of musical instruments have reached extraordinary heights. I'd like to make Xiao an immortal of music...

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: You flatter me.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: But then that Hyunmu appeared and got in the way... I'd like to do something, but being forbidden to meddle in mortal affairs is frustrating.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: If I intervened, our superiors would surely punish me, and things would happen that the people here couldn't possibly handle. Utter chaos...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: If that doesn't make sense, read that book about immortals someday. Romance of... something or other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I will. Oh, Xiaowei. Are you feeling all right?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'm fine, %s.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Master Zhengyang... I know it's shameless for one so unworthy to ask... but please lend me your strength.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Well, when you ask like that, I can hardly turn a blind eye. But we have to be rather careful ourselves just now...

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Not long ago, we somehow ended up fighting the Dragon Kings, uprooting Mount Tai, and planting it in the roof of the Dragon Palace...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: They started it, mind you. Still... it can't be helped. I'll offer a tiny bit of help, out of the Queen Mother of the West's sight.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Will that be all right, Junior Sister?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: How generous of you, Senior Brother. And what help will you offer?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: My junior sister here is the finest talent among the Eight Immortals. Our greatest strategist!

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Well, it's a good approach, but isn't that rather irresponsible of you?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hohoho! Aren't you the best even in the immortal realm?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Anyway, you there, adventurer? The setting is just right. I'll help you, so would you gather a few ingredients for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, me?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Who else is standing there? Anyway, I'll draw on heavenly wisdom to make an elixir that will let you defeat Hyunmu. It's nothing difficult, so don't be afraid.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: I need [Ancient Ginseng]. I'm sorry this is all the help I can offer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's all right. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Good luck. Surprisingly quick to act, aren't they? Already gone...

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Thank you... For helping someone so unworthy...

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Just get some rest, Xiao. For that child's sake too.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: What? What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Here they come.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: I'm surprised they found it so quickly. Perhaps they are...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Shh, Junior Sister. For now, we're only here to help.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back. It wasn't as hard to find as I expected.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Good. The elixir won't be difficult to make. Keep my senior brother company for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, where's Xiaowei?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Don't worry. She's just asleep for a little while. What shall we talk about? Do you like idols?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Idols?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Yes, idols. There's one I'm quite fond of lately...

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: The elixir is ready!

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hoho, what a shame. I could have talked for hours.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Be thankful I finished so quickly. Otherwise, he'd have spent the whole night reciting everything he likes about his favorite idol.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Here, drink it all down. Adventurer, a fine energy will... Hmm? Don't you trust me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not that.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Then let me explain briefly. My senior brother, myself, and six others are known as the Eight Immortals. This medicine will connect our spirits to yours...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: That may be a bit complicated, Junior Sister. Put simply, you'll borrow a little of our power. Mortals must handle mortal affairs, but when things get difficult, we sometimes do this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's medicine that gives me an immortal's power. Is it safe to drink?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Hahaha! Dead this way or dead that way, what's the difference?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Oops, that came out wrong. Just drink it down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gulp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It tastes awful, but I feel stronger. What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Go and defeat Hyunmu. You're connected to the power of the Eight Immortals, so it shouldn't be too difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei got hurt because of me. I'll take care of this.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Believe in me. Believe in us. You may find strength you never had before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I believe you. I'll go defeat Hyunmu now.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Off you go. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Junior Sister, what do you make of that adventurer?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: That adventurer will do well. A mortal who survived drinking the Elixir of the Eight Immortals, after all.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: True enough... Shall we watch, then?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Let's. And it's about time Xiao woke up.
(After Hyunmu falls, an unknown energy begins to fill the space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I defeated Hyunmu. I won.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I did it!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hyunmu's treasures, which I hadn't noticed before, begin to catch my eye.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I take them? I defeated Hyunmu, so... I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unfamiliar emotion takes hold of me. I certainly didn't feel this way a moment ago...)
(Xiaowei appears in the distance and approaches %s with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Wonderful! You defeated Hyunmu completely!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Now we just need to destroy the treasures tainted by its evil aura and purify Shangri-La. Then we'll set up a barrier to keep evil beings like Hyunmu away, and everything will be...

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Well done, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xiaowei is saying something, but I can't hear it...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What are you saying?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is all mine!! You're going to take it all away? I won't let you!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Adventurer? Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay back. This is all mine!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: You must come to your senses! %s, you've fallen under the lingering effects of Hyunmu's evil spell!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay back!! Or else...

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: (Can I do this in my condition? Should I retreat? But if I leave them, they'll become another Hyunmu.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: (I can't abandon someone who fought despite knowing the danger.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: ...Then I have no choice. I will face you myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's coming at me with a weapon. She must be after the treasure here! I have to defeat her...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xiaowei is smiling. Why? Why...?)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: It's all right... %s.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'll save you. Just hold on a little longer.
(The impact of the last attack sends Xiaowei flying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't you dare take my treasure!! Hah!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'm sorry... I should have saved you...
(Xiaowei sinks to the ground, unable to get up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This treasure is mine. I won't let anyone else touch it. So...
(A powerful force shakes Hyunmu's Cave just as the weapon is raised toward Xiaowei, knocking it from %s's hand to the floor.)
Stop!!
(A commanding male voice follows, and my gaze turns naturally toward it.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: You're...
Miss Xiaowei, leave this sort of thing to me. You know this is my department.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yes...
You there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?
(The suspicious man murmurs something quietly in my direction.)
Yes, you! Take a good look at the person you're about to hurt!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Obviously, someone trying to steal my treasure...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My mind is in turmoil... The man is just standing in front of me, but I feel an unknown power.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels like something is burning in the darkness. Piercing right through me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... Ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-why did I...?
(When %s comes to, a smartly suited young man stands nearby. After checking %s's condition, he helps Xiaowei up.)
You're back. Recovering from Hyunmu's influence should take quite some time. Perhaps you have a strong will...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did I do that...? Oh, Xiaowei! Xiaowei! Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'm fine. More importantly, thank you for stopping them, Kazno.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Sure, Xiao. Been well?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Y-yes... Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kazno...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I've heard that name somewhere... Definitely somewhere... Where was it...?)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Miss Xiaowei, it'll be hard to perform with injuries like these, won't it?
(The man called Kazno places a hand over Xiaowei's wounds. As some power gradually closes them, her expression relaxes.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Thank you. I've felt this power before, but it's still amazing to see.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Xiao! Xiao! Are you all right?
(Lan Caihe and Zhongli Quan hurry over.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'm fine, Master Zhengyang, Master Yangso.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: We came running when this youngster's aura grew dim, but it seems everything has been resolved. Oh, you're...

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Kazno Nas?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I'm surprised an immortal knows me. I'm flattered.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: It would be harder not to recognize someone as famous as you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, is this Kazno person famous?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (...We'd better give a suitable explanation. Junior Sister, if you would.)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (Leave it to me.)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: A master who conquered the Elias Arena and saved the Elias royal family from a crisis...

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: And a womanizer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, a womanizer!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Sigh. A womanizer? Popular as I may be, that's hardly a fair way to see me.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Just from what I've seen myself... Oh, never mind.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well, whatever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, Kazno. There's something I'd like to ask...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Oh, look at the time. Take care, Miss Xiaowei. Goodbye to the rest of you too. Stay well.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: And you as well.
(Having said only what he wanted to say, Kazno disappears.)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (Junior Sister, it seems he noticed, doesn't it?)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (Should we have subdued him here? Though I'm not sure we could have...)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (Perhaps if Lei Lei had appeared, things might be different.)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (Lei has little interest in anything unrelated to herself. Still... Ah, shall we stop here? I think we're about to be noticed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you two just standing there without saying anything?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hoho, nothing at all.
(Zhongli Quan and Lan Caihe exchange broad smiles.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is strange here...)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (Perhaps this person is...)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Well, shall we head back? Junior Sister, I'll take Miss Xiaowei home. Please put a barrier around Shangri-La.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Of course. Take good care of Xiao. Now, what sort of barrier will earn me a fine reputation? Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: %s, you should head back too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels like something happened that I don't understand...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Xiaowei?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Thank you for today. I owe you a great debt. Be sure to visit me when you're in Yong Gyoung.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm the one who did something terrible, and you...

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Don't let that trouble you too much. We'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: The cloud that just arrived is quite sturdy. We should reach Yong Gyoung without incident. Oh, you should visit Aoich.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aoich...?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: That's an interesting place too. See you all later. Do stay out of trouble.
(As soon as the farewells are over, the immortals ride their clouds into the sky. Soon the clouds disappear in the directions of their respective destinations.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something going to happen...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall I head to Aoich, then?

steps.name: Dark Moon Princess
steps.objective: Talk to [Ame] in "Aoich", then find the [Dark Moon Princess] at the "Sixteenth Moon" inside "Dark Moon Castle".

lines.text: (Splendid old buildings, every bit as ornate and impressive as those of Yong Gyoung, fill the view.)
(By contrast, the streets seem calm and quiet... Or so I think, until...)
(A loud commotion comes from behind me.)
Move, move, move, move!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better step aside and see what happens.)
Stop right there, Ame! Don't run away!
(The woman called Ame, pursued by someone, looks around desperately for a hiding place.)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Tch. No choice. I can't let Tamori catch me like this...
(Ame glances at the river beside the road, then throws herself into it in a flash.)
(Ame's head emerges from the water. As though nothing is wrong, she deftly swims through the current and heads away.)
Whew. Lost her. This is bad...
(A moment later, a man emerges from the crowd and stares anxiously at the river. From what people are saying, he seems to be the man called 'Tamori.')

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: If she keeps breaking into the castle and the other shikigami catch her, everyone will be in trouble... It's the same thing every time with her. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something seems to be going on.
Tamori's gone, right? He's really gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're the one who went into the water...

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Yep, yep. That was me. Whew. I didn't want to jump in and ruin my favorite outfit, but I had no choice.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Ugh, listen to this.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: I'm friends with the princess who lives in Dark Moon Castle over there. The Dark Moon Princess. Things at the castle have felt strange lately, so I went to check on her.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: And they threw me out!! I was furious. So I've been trying to sneak in and find out what's going on, but it's not working. I keep getting spotted and chased off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's impressive.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: That warrior captain Tamori is especially tough. He's at least as good as any regular ninja, if not better. But still! Next time I won't lose! I'm getting in!
(Ame burns with determination, vowing to try again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Earlier, that Tamori person said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Ame what Tamori was muttering to himself.)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Oh, really? What should I do?

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Hey, judging by your clothes, you're an adventurer, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Other adventurers take commissions. Do you? I'll make it an official job, so help me out!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do...?)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Please? Please?
(Ame slowly studies %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I suppose. What do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Nothing much! Go into the castle and meet the Dark Moon Princess. Make sure she's all right and give her this letter!

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Just tell her Ame is worried about her. I'll have your payment ready, so don't worry about that.
(Ame presses a letter into %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I've accepted the request, so I suppose I have to go.)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Just keep heading inward to reach Dark Moon Castle. I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I'll be back.
I can't believe an intruder like you is pushing me back!
(The girl who attacked without warning the moment we met steps back and voices her frustration.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, just hear me out. You're the princess, right? The Dark Moon Princess?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: That's right. And I still have no intention of listening.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What shall I do with this intruder? I suppose I'll have to fight hard enough to bring the castle down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: H-hey, wait a moment!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'll hear your excuses in the dungeon.
(The look in the Dark Moon Princess's eyes changes.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Prepare yourself!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What? It's like she's a completely different person from a moment ago. Where is this terrifying power coming from...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Your mind is wandering in the middle of a fight?
(Only then do I notice the arrow the Dark Moon Princess has fired. But a small fan flies in from somewhere and knocks it down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (W-what was that?)
My daughter is wonderful in every way, except for that hasty temper. Cough.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father? It's dangerous for you to come out now! This intruder is no ordinary foe!
It's all right, my princess. Take a good look, won't you? Our intruder friend doesn't seem hostile.
(A pale but pleasant-looking young man studies %s's face alongside the Dark Moon Princess.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, if you're the princess's father...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Indeed. I am the master of this castle, the Dark Moon Lord. Others might mistake me for her older brother, but I am her father.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, one more remark like that and you can forget the snack I was going to bring you.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Forgive me, my dear daughter. You're already upset about those plotting against Dark Moon Castle. I shouldn't add to your troubles.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Cough, cough. I'm sorry my chronic illness has left me in such a sorry state.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, I know you're fine right now.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: My beloved princess has seen right through me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes, Father. Don't overdo it. Now then, you there. Why did you come? Explain yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been asking you to listen this whole time...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Please don't be upset. Would you tell us what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. I'll explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hand Ame's letter to the Dark Moon Princess.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Oh, Ame...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: You're quite remarkable yourself. Making it all the way here to deliver a letter takes real skill. At any rate, thank you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Sorry. I thought you'd come for some other purpose. And thank you for bringing Ame's letter. I'll contact her right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My job is done, so I'll be leaving. Huh, Princess?
(The Dark Moon Princess catches %s by the hem of their clothes. She seems to have something to say.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Ahem. You there. Go wait outside. I'll be right there.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Princess, surely you don't mean...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's this all about?)

steps.name: Mino's Jewel
steps.objective:
1. Hear about <Mino's Jewel> in front of Dark Moon Castle, then find [Cardiff] in "Elfa".
2. Check what happens in front of the "Pyramid Chamber".
3. Defeat [Sphinx] inside the "Pyramid Chamber" and obtain the [Sand Crystal]. Then take the portal out of the "Pyramid Chamber" and assess the situation.
4. Once the situation is resolved, return to "Aoich" and find the [Dark Moon Princess].
5. Find [Ramua] in "Elfa".

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You seem reasonably capable, so I'm giving you a mission. Accept it without complaint.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, why should I...?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Refusing isn't an option. I'll refuse your refusal. Complete the mission, and I'll graciously forgive the disturbance you caused inside the castle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This sounds like trouble... I'd better just get it over with.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Now, pay attention! All you're thinking is that you should get it over with quickly, aren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You're so easy to read. Listen carefully. I'll explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. All right...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Among Dark Moon Castle's treasures is something called 'Mino's Jewel.' It can expand its user's magical power without limit. Such a priceless treasure...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Princess, a moment...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, I know what you're going to say. Please leave this to me.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: All right. I understand.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: A few years ago, a battle here cracked the jewel. We thought a crack wouldn't matter... But its magical power began to disappear.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Sigh... It was the work of the traitors from Owl Castle who were after my father.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there a way to repair it?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Sending it away for repairs is difficult. Without it, we have trouble summoning Tengu, the guardian deity of Dark Moon Castle.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Summoning a guardian as powerful as Tengu strains even a great shaman like my father...

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: To think my daughter respects me so deeply! Your father is moved to tears.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: My esteemed father, please compose yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: To keep Tengu summoned and preserve my father's health...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You must go to Elfa.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You look unconvinced... There's another Mino's Jewel in Elfa. One just like ours.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'd like you to borrow it. Meet Cardiff, the leader of the desert people and their great warrior, and explain the situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that all?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes. I'd like to go myself, but Dark Moon Castle is unsettled, and I need to watch over my father...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: This mission is important to Aoich, so please do your best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I'll go. I hope nothing happens here while I'm away.
(Once %s disappears beyond Dark Moon Castle, the lord looks at his daughter.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Daughter.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes, Father?

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Are you sure we can entrust something so important to that person? This isn't like you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You felt it too, Father. There's something different about them... I just think they'll do well.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: True, but you could have entrusted it to someone like Tamori. That's why I ask.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: As long as they do a good job, it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (They didn't feel unfamiliar.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (They remind me of that woman I hate, pretending to be so kind... How irritating...)
I've been waiting. You're the one sent from Dark Moon Castle.
(A man stands at the place the Dark Moon Princess described. His stance seems ordinary, but his presence is like a wild beast hiding its claws.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's the leader of the twelve desert tribes. Their great warrior...)

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: My name is Cardiff. You match the description in the Dark Moon Lord's letter, so I recognized you immediately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I hope the owl that delivered the letter made it back safely...
(Cardiff looks up at the sky with a worried expression.)

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Forgive me. I've kept our guest waiting. Shall we discuss Mino's Jewel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weren't you simply going to lend it to us?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: You're in a hurry. Hear me out. I'd like nothing better than to lend it to you immediately, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Please explain.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Aoich and Elfa have been like brothers since long ago. Lending Mino's Jewel would be no trouble.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: The question is whether it still exists.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a moment. Isn't it a real object?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Unlike Aoich, which has continued using its jewel, Elfa is a little...

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Aoich gave it to us long ago, before either Elfa or Aoich became part of the Kingdom of Elias.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Back when Pushuhushu still smoked pipes, as they say.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: When the pyramid was built in the desert, the leader of that time dedicated many treasures to the royal tomb. Mino's Jewel was among them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why put it in a pyramid...?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: They say it was buried there as a prayer for the prosperity of their descendants.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That pyramid is an ancient ruin now, right? Is it dangerous to enter alone?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Even if you're skilled, I wonder whether you can withstand an ancient curse. And the barrier built to keep that curse from spreading has been destroyed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't there anything we can do?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Come to think of it, the timing isn't bad. %s, would you go to the pyramid?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All of a sudden?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I've assigned a man named [Ban Giu] a task concerning the pyramid. I'd like you to investigate inside with him while searching for Mino's Jewel...

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I'd like to help as well, but my duties keep me rather busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. From what you've said, going into the pyramid with him sounds manageable. I'll head there now.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Yes, take care. As a warrior of Elfa, let me offer a brief prayer. May the hand that holds your weapon always be guided by steadfast faith.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Gone before I even finished the prayer.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: That fearless air reminds me of the youngster Ban Giu mentioned...
(A young man dressed like a delinquent looks puzzled at the sight of %s.)
What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...
Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Ban Giu, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The one Cardiff assigned a task to...
(Ban Giu nods.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: That's me. What's this about? What do you want with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain the situation to Ban Giu.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Huh? There was something like that here? Well, fine, but getting mixed up with that horrible princess? No thanks. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know the Dark Moon Princess?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Do I ever! She's so horrib... Ah, she might be listening somewhere, so let's say adorable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sounds like she's put him through a lot.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Ugh, just thinking about it wears me out. I can feel my energy draining away...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: I have business in the burial chamber at the center of the pyramid. What did you say your name was?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm %s. Just call me that.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Got it, %s. While I search for Mino's Jewel, you deal with the guardian here, the Sphinx.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: There's treasure everywhere in here, but finding something with real power isn't easy.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: That's where I come in. I can handle that sort of thing without a problem.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Finding the real thing, disarming traps... It takes longer than you'd think, so don't come looking for me while you're fighting the Sphinx.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Don't ask that. Just think of it as... dividing up the work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: You look capable... And the Dark Moon Princess sent you, so I don't need to worry, right?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: I'm counting on you, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Wow, you've already finished in there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Once I got started...

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: You're fast enough to remind me of someone. Oh, and with skills every bit as fine as yours, I found that Mino-whatever jewel.
(Ban Giu takes a jewel with a strange aura out of his pocket.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is it.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Hey, don't just stare at it. Give me some praise too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Hehe. I did a great job, didn't I? While finding what you needed, I found what I needed too.
(Looking exceedingly pleased, Ban Giu takes out a greatsword and shows it to me.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Haha! This should definitely help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Nothing much. Anyway, the old man's here. If you came all this way, you could at least help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Is someone else here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...
Your senses are as sharp as ever, brat.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Come on out, great warrior.
(Cardiff slowly steps out of the shadows across from us.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: You were watching everything, weren't you? We're all done here.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: You, the one sent by the Dark Moon Princess... Your skill is remarkable. I hadn't expected so much.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: You think so too, old man? I haven't seen skills like that since back then.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: You mean Kazno...

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: The Sphinx won't be moving for a while now. Hurry up and restore the pyramid's barrier.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: This will suffice for the pyramid. And I grant ownership of the sword you found to the 'Priestess of the Sea Dragon King.'

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Thanks, old man.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I gave my word as the great warrior of the desert. Naturally, I will honor it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what is that sword?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Well, that is...

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Old man, stop.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: It seems the woman this brat has fallen for needed that greatsword. And it happened to be in the pyramid.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Finding it in this pyramid would be like finding a coin dropped from the sky...

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Yet he found it. Remarkable. A natural talent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, that's impressive.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: You don't need to tell them all that.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: You're doing this to save the woman you love. Make sure you see it through.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Thanks, old man. I'm off.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Hey, %s. Where are you heading? Dark Moon Castle?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I have the jewel, I should go back to the princess.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: If you don't know where to go afterward, try Poe Mansion. It'll be fun.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: (The brat's taking his pranks a little far.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go if I remember.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Good. Don't tell the Dark Moon Princess you saw me. Take care, old man. I'm off.
(Ban Giu disappears the instant he finishes speaking.)

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Though you came at the Dark Moon Princess's request, you also helped us set things right in the pyramid. Thank you for your excellent work.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: The princess has a keen eye, as expected. She wouldn't send just anyone... Cough, cough. The air here is terrible. Let's get out quickly too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go see the Dark Moon Princess.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Yes, farewell. Give her my regards.
(In front of Dark Moon Castle, the Dark Moon Princess waits in the distance with an anxious expression.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Oh, you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were you waiting for me?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: W-who said I was waiting? I just happened to have business outside.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: If Choen were here, I wouldn't have had to wait. Hmph.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Someone I know. We used to... with Iris...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Look what you've made me talk about. Honestly, you...
(The Dark Moon Princess grows angry as she speaks. The name Iris seems to strike a nerve.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Here, the jewel.
(I hand Mino's Jewel to the Dark Moon Princess.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You took a little while. Did something happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell the Dark Moon Princess about the trip to the pyramid, leaving out Ban Giu as he requested.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Really? It feels like someone's missing from that story. Is that really all?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Cardiff returned to Elfa, and I came here.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: All right. And well done. You don't need to worry about the jewel anymore.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Th-thank you. And next time you come to Aoich, tell me about your travels.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: So, where are you going now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somewhere I haven't been before, I suppose.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: If you don't know where to go, head back to Elfa for now. Find an Ases girl named Ramua... No, forget it. Hmph!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Princess. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She really can't say what she means...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Ases...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Shall I head to Elfa for now?)
(A girl in clothes quite different from those of the townspeople stands on an Elfa street.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She looks very busy...)

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Protocol reset... Connecting to the Hyperspace Network... Why does it keep disconnecting...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Who are you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce myself. I'm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly introduce myself to Ramua.)

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: I'm experiencing a temporary error, so my responses are delayed... This hardly ever happens. It feels like signal interference...

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Is it because you've arrived, adventurer? Anyway, I'm sorry... You can't reach Atlantis through the Town Portal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then how can I get there?

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Go past Elfa Harbor to the sandy shore of Orca Beach...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Um... I heard you're one of the Ases, Ramua...

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: I'm from Midgard, but I suppose I should say the Ases are my ancestors, not me... Still, I carry out work they assign me...

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: To operate a machine that moves through space and time... you need someone with a special gift called 'access ability,' and that's...

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: I don't know how much help I am to Lady Sarasvati...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sarasvati?)

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: I can't share the details... without authorization... Confidential work information...

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Ugh... There's an error I need to fix. I'm sorry. I'm busy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Ramua. Thank you. I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If you can move through space and time, does that mean you can travel back to the distant past, or into the future...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Complicated. Hmm... Maybe I'll rest a little... Huh? Why do I feel like I should visit the mansion Ban Giu mentioned?)

steps.name: Gothic Room
steps.objective: Meet the [Dark Moon Princess] at the entrance to "Poe Mansion", then defeat [Pandora] inside. Afterward, talk to the [Dark Moon Princess] outside the mansion.

lines.text: (My steps come to a halt at a gloomy place with an uncanny atmosphere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This must be Poe Mansion, the place Ban Giu mentioned.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What made him call this place fun?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's creepy...
Huh? %s, what are you doing here?
(Someone notices %s from a patch of deep shadow and walks over.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What a strange place to run into you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It certainly is.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You must come back to Aoich someday. Understood? I'll hold a proper banquet for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Anyway, you. I thought you'd leave Aoich for somewhere else. What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone told me to stop by if I was passing through.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Some people really do give useless advice. Why here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What brings you here, Princess?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's a long story. For now, I'm here because there's someone I have to rescue from this ominous mansion.
Oh? Are you talking about Lord Levi?
(Someone suddenly joins the conversation.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: I'm Lunaresa, a servant of Lady Pandora. You may call me Vampanella if you like.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You know Lord Levi? I don't care who you are. Tell me about him, now!!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Lord Levi used to visit here often when he was a child.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I've never heard that before. He never mentioned anything like that...

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: You don't know Lord Levi very well, do you? His soul belongs to Lady Pandora.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What are you talking about? How can a person's soul belong to someone else? Unless they're a demon or a witch...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Wait. Pandora...

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Bingo! Lady Pandora is a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's this about a witch?)

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: An all-knowing, all-powerful witch, no less! She resurrected Lord Levi's shattered soul!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What are you saying?!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: During the battle with the Demon King, Lord Levi's soul returned to Lady Pandora. He was revived through an [Agasura Contract].

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Ah, how great my mistress is.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi was killed by the Demon King? They didn't all come back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is about the companions who traveled with Iris...)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Don't make me laugh. Stop talking nonsense!!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Oh my. He's been safely resurrected now, so there's no need to be so angry!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Sigh. Enough. %s, you! Help me. I said, help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Are you going to take Lord Levi away?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'll tear this entire mansion down if that's what it takes to bring him back. Remember that!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Will you really, Your. High. Ness?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is going on...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I don't want to spend another second here. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (Please wait, Lord Levi...)
(In one part of the mansion, a young man gazes this way with vacant eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that Levi?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi! You really are here!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi, are you all right? Lord... Levi?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I thought someone called me. Where? I hear a voice somewhere...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...A familiar voice...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Am I imagining it? My head feels a little foggy... Ah, I have to go to Lady Pandora. Lady Pandora...
(Levi looks around, then walks straight past the Dark Moon Princess.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi! Lord Levi!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I can't believe it. I'm calling him right in front of him. How can he ignore me...?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Ah, no...
(As though realizing something, the Dark Moon Princess turns a venomous look on Lunaresa, who is trailing behind.)

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Hehe... You see...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tell me, now!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: It's my mistress's magic. Our great mistress!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I've never heard of magic like that. Never...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then that means...

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Lord Levi's soul is currently cut off from this world, in another space.

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: If you leave them alone, he'll enjoy an eternal teatime with Lady Pandora. Please don't interfere and spoil it!
(The Dark Moon Princess's expression twists.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Is that so? Then all I need to do is defeat your mistress?

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: My mistress took in Lord Levi's soul, so if her power disappears... Hmm.

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: But can you really face Lady Pandora, Princess? She's an Agasura and a witch who commands advanced magic!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know what an Agasura is, but what's this about a witch?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph. I had to face Pandora sooner or later anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess, will you be all right?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Why wouldn't I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Going to face that Agasura... Pandora.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You can go back if you're scared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not that...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Then stop talking and follow me. We'll defeat Pandora and save Lord Levi!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Well now, as Lady Pandora's loyal servant, I, Lunaresa, can't help you. But good luck! ♬
(Lunaresa disappears somewhere the instant she finishes speaking.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...I really don't like her. %s, %s! What are you thinking so hard about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: We don't know what Pandora has done to this place, so stay close to me. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Princess.
(Defeated in battle, Pandora looks at the Dark Moon Princess with apparent resignation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That battle was much harder than I expected.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Well? Something to say, Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A true member of the Black Moon clan. You've changed greatly since before...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph. Don't underestimate me, Pandora the witch.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Now, witch Pandora. This is goodbye! An Agasura like you is...
(The Dark Moon Princess aims her bow at Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess, please stop!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi?
(Startled by Levi's arrival, the Dark Moon Princess accidentally releases her grip. Levi swings his sword and knocks the flying arrow away.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...Are you both all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That man, Levi... He blocked the arrow flying toward Pandora so easily.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi, I-I... I wasn't trying to attack you.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm all right. Please don't worry.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess, I have a request. Please do not harm her.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What? That woman is a witch and an Agasura!! She put us in danger a few years ago too. And now she's done something terrible to you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A lot must have happened in the past...)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: As you say, Princess, the relationship between Pandora and me is nothing more or less than a contract. This happened under the terms of that contract. Lady Pandora is not at fault.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: After what happened back then, I owe my continued life entirely to Lady Pandora's magic... Please, I ask you to stand down.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Since you ask, Lord Levi, I will. I only wanted to rescue you. I don't care whether the witch lives or dies.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you, Princess. And thank you as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: You have a feeling like Iris's... Ah, never mind.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Dark Moon Princess. Shall we leave?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi, are you really all right? Can you go back now? I...
(The Dark Moon Princess eagerly takes Levi's hand. Then, as though realizing something, she lets go and turns her back.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I-I'm glad you're all right.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi, you have no idea how worried Herne is. Ah, I'll let you finish speaking. I'll wait outside.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s, come with me. Don't just stand there like an idiot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right. We'll wait outside, then.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you, Princess.
(Once everyone has left, Levi holds out a hand to Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora, my life is certainly yours. But there are things I must do elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Do as you wish...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: After resuming my duties at court, I will visit you again. Please take care of your injuries.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If that is your choice...
(Levi bids Pandora farewell and leaves the mansion.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi... Having lost your 'deepest feelings' in exchange for your life, what meaning does the outside world hold for you?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Swept along by others' wishes, fighting a reckless battle against the Demon King... You even lost your life.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi, I want to give you meaning that the world cannot. You must understand that I can be that person for you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess, thank you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I didn't do it because I wanted your thanks.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Since you're helping me, do one more thing. It isn't difficult. I'll reward you properly when you visit Dark Moon Castle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Please accompany Lord Levi to Elias. He may still feel unsettled...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I have to go. Father tends to start coughing up blood about now.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi, until we meet again. I must leave first to see to my father.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess, will you be all right on your own?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Didn't you see? I'm well enough to teach a witch a lesson. So please entrust your journey to %s over there.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Lord Levi, I mean... Ah, never mind. I'll be going.
(The Dark Moon Princess runs toward the quiet, dark forest path.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we go too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi, what's on your mind?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Nothing. Let us head to Elias.

steps.name: To the Palace
steps.objective: Talk to Levi in front of the "Elias Royal Palace", then go to "Hejong".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. We've reached the palace, so I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Where are you heading?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm thinking of going to Ves or Atlantis.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Would you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Please wait until I have finished my audience with His Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's only a moment, that's fine...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you.
(Not long after Levi enters the palace, a loud commotion rises from within.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is it so noisy?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm sorry to keep you waiting. After I explained to His Majesty, he ordered me to bring you inside.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: He said, 'All my subjects, give the adventurer an enthusiastic welcome'... So quite a few people have gathered.
(Behind Levi, a large crowd waits inside the palace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please show me the way, Levi.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Follow me.
(Inside the palace, a man wearing a dragon robe looks on with a kindly expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty...?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Your Majesty, this is the adventurer %s.
Oh, so you're the one who rescued Sir Levi? Raise your head.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Welcome to the Elias Palace. I am King Hejong. And this is my daughter, Herne.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, adventurer! I heard you saved Sir Levi!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Dark Moon Princess did more than I did.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: The princess sent us a letter by raven, and she had nothing but praise for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Dark Moon Princess praised me? Somehow that's even scarier...)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Thank you for helping Sir Levi.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I am grateful as well. Let us leave the thanks there for now. I have a request for you.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I hear you are searching for Iris, like many other adventurers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris...)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Your achievements and abilities are exceptional. You may be able to find her. But you will need to get a little closer.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: As an adventurer who has come to Elias, I would like you to approach the search for Iris with particular care.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Iris is a benefactor of our kingdom, and I dearly wish to find her. But it is no easy task. Many have searched in vain and given up...

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Judging by your expression, you don't intend to give up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I want to find Iris...

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: If you go to Atlantis, you may discover something about her whereabouts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atlantis...

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: You can reach the underwater city of Atlantis, but it is a closed society. They have rules forbidding contact with us surface dwellers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: There is a woman who is close to Anastasia, the mayor of Atlantis. Her name is Gatia Su, the Priestess of the Sea Dragon King.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Ask her for help. Then perhaps the mayor of Atlantis will assist you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gatia Su...

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Master Sunsung, who visits Elias from time to time, should know where the priestess is. He's in Ves at present.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Then I leave it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty. I understand.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Do not overexert yourself.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s, this should really be my duty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Levi. I came here to find Iris, so it's my duty too. Just take good care of yourself until we meet again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come back with Iris. I promise.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes. I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then I should head to Ves. I hope Master Sunsung hasn't gone anywhere...)

steps.name: The Rampaging Sea Dragon King
steps.objective: 1. Hear about the [Sea Dragon King] from [Sunsung] in "Ves".\n2. Listen to the voice at the entrance to the "Chilled Heart" beneath the "Kthuka Ruins".\n3. Pierce the [Sea Dragon King's] heart with <Durendal> to purify it, then meet and talk to [Gatia Su].

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Well now, an adventurer I haven't seen before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Master Sunsung?

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Indeed. I'm Sunsung. Not Sinsung. Sunsung.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Fine weather today, isn't it? Ves is a little humid, but this is paradise. Or perhaps I should say the Pure Land! Haha.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: You look like you have something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. His Majesty, the King of Elias, sent me.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: His Majesty? Let's hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Sunsung that Hejong asked me to find Gatia Su.)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Gatia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Nothing serious. So perhaps I can take it that you've come to help that boy Ban Giu...

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: If His Majesty entrusted you with a task, your abilities must be fairly good...

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: (Mutter, mutter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Here, take this. It's called Durendal.
(Master Sunsung produces a sword from somewhere and places it in %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: It is a holy sword, known as a sword of truth that harms no living being and can separate light from darkness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why have you brought it out?

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Gatia is near the Sea Dragon King right now. His aura is filled with malice, so she is keeping watch over his condition.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Ban Giu tried to use this to drain the Sea Dragon King's energy and calm him, but he failed. Durendal is surprisingly difficult to wield if it isn't compatible with its user...

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: In any case, he returned here, left the sword with me, then headed straight back.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: And now you have come to me looking for Gatia. Perhaps this is no coincidence. Maybe the sword wanted to meet you.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Hold the sword and take a deep breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I take a deep breath as Master Sunsung instructs... The heavy sword suddenly feels light. What is this...?)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: It seems the sword suits you. I can spot these things at a glance. Haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel a mysterious energy. This is...)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Keep your wits about you. Power gained easily can just as easily fall apart while you're off guard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I'm all right so far.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Take it to the Kthuka Ruins and look deep within for a place called the 'Chilled Heart.'

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: However skilled Ban Giu may be from adventuring with Iris, facing a powerful divine beast alone is too much for him.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Go and help him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Then good luck.
(The ruins shake, and voices reach me through the rumbling.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우의 목소리
lines.text: I knew it. Is this impossible without Durendal?

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Ban, fall back! We have no choice but to retreat for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who's that? One voice is Ban Giu's, but the other...?

lines.speaker: 반 기우의 목소리
lines.text: I can't retreat. I can't leave you behind.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I am the priestess who serves the Sea Dragon King. If anything happens to him, I must remain here...

lines.speaker: 반 기우의 목소리
lines.text: Don't say that, Gatia!!

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Ban, look out!!
(The cry of an enormous, furious creature shakes the ruins. Its overwhelming presence is enough to make living beings collapse in terror.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Ugh, this power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to go in. Somehow, I'll...)
(The sea fog is so thick that Ban Giu can barely see as he slowly surveys the area.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: ...Is it over?
(The Sea Dragon King closes his eyes. His enormous body begins sinking slowly, then swiftly descends beneath the water.)
The Sea Dragon King's strength is completely spent. He seems to have fallen asleep again. Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: That's a relief, but now I owe this one again. Anyway, thanks for helping.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing...

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Durendal... You seem better at using it than I am.
The one who exhausted the Sea Dragon King's strength... Ban, who is this person?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Gatia, this is the friend I met in the desert when I was looking for Durendal. They've helped us again.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Ah, let me introduce myself properly. I am the priestess... Gatia Su.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Thank you for your help, adventurer. But what brings you all the way here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain that I'm traveling in search of Iris, and came because I need Gatia Su's help to reach Atlantis.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I see.
(Gatia Su listens, then falls into thought for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: The priestess still has work to do. Even if the Sea Dragon King is asleep... Anyway, why didn't Durendal suit me...?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Is there something different about you? (Scratch, scratch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't really know either.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I belong to a line of priestesses who have served the Sea Dragon King since ancient times... There were once many of us, but now I am the only one left.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: A priestess serves as a bridge between humans and the Sea Dragon King, two very different beings. Through his power, I may have lived longer than my appearance suggests.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Durendal allowed us to stop his rampage, but we do not know what else may happen. The influence of some power he currently holds...
(Before Gatia Su can finish, a hazy form appears from the water. It looks like a smaller phantom of the Sea Dragon King.)

lines.speaker: 해룡왕의 영체
lines.text: I am all right, Gatia Su. And you, my kin, I regained my senses thanks to you!

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Ah! Sea Dragon King, are you well?

lines.speaker: 해룡왕의 영체
lines.text: Gatia Su, I say again, I am all right! My body has fallen asleep to recover. I'm sorry that appearing like this to offer my thanks is all I can manage.

lines.speaker: 해룡왕의 영체
lines.text: After I rest a little, I'll call for you, Gatia... Ah, my time is up. Forgive me, everyone...
(The Sea Dragon King's spirit slowly fades.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Sea Dragon King... What a relief...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Excuse me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: The Sea Dragon King seems to think highly of your 'power.'

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: So the Sea Dragon King really is a creature of great spiritual insight? Oh, come to think of it, if you're looking for Iris, you must know some of her traveling companions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've met Zoe, Muwen, the Dark Moon Princess, and Levi.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: And we're here, so that covers us. Have you seen Choen too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: At first, I thought she was a pretty decent woman. I never imagined she'd do something like that. If you ever see her, don't let her fool you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Despite her appearance, she does whatever she wants. And in the end... she betrayed us... Or maybe I should say she seemed to enjoy what was happening. Anyway!

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: With a character like that, she must have been an Agasura. What did she want so badly that she traveled with us?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't understand. What on earth happened...?)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Forgive me for interrupting. You said you were going to Atlantis, correct?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Our recent battle has opened the waterway to Atlantis.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: If you continue down along the coast, you may be able to reach it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go, then.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Um, %s. I know it's a lot to ask, but could you help us a little longer?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Gatia... Is this about the Priestess of Fire?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Yes. Those who mean the Sea Dragon King harm are plotting something. To be honest, I fear we cannot handle it with our strength alone...

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't be more help...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: That's not true. Um, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are they Agasura too...? Should I get involved? Maybe I could learn something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help you.
(Gatia Su smiles gently.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You remind me of Miss Iris. That pure wish to help others...

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: What a beautiful smile.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Please follow me. We will go to the Priestess of Fire.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Of course. I'll go anywhere you go, Gatia.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Ah, Ban. You cannot enter this place. Only priestesses and those with a special power may do so... Please wait outside.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Oh, r-really? Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's going on with these two...? Sigh. For now, let's go see this Priestess of Fire.)

steps.name: Kthuka's Priestess
steps.objective: Defeat [Koa] in the "Heart of Kthuka" in the "Kthuka Ruins", then talk to [Gatia Su].

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Your sudden arrival caught me off guard, but...

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: You're no ordinary person. To make me struggle like this...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Priestess of the Sea Dragon King... Now you've stooped to borrowing someone else's power to reach me. How treacherous.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Ugh, this is infuriating. I was so close to bringing down the Sea Dragon King...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop this. Why are you doing any of this?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Who are you? This has nothing to do with... Ah, you are...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Priestess of Flame, what were you planning to do to the Sea Dragon King?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Why ask me? My children won't be safe until that wicked demon god of the sea is defeated.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: I know you're trying to send the Sea Dragon King berserk and annihilate all of Kthuka.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: W-wait a moment. Who told you that? Who said someone was making him rampage...?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Gatia, Priestess of Water. So it was you, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You seem to have seriously misunderstood. Explain yourself.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: It wasn't you?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Do you believe a priestess could commit the sacrilege of exploiting the being she serves? Koa, Priestess of Fire. What have you heard?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Are you saying you aren't responsible for the Sea Dragon King's instability over the past few years?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I swear it in the name of the Sea Dragon King and every god.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You heard that story from Choen, didn't you? What did you see in her that made you trust her?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Th-that...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You are Agasura. Surely you did not trust each other.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: The [Crawling Chaos] would never do that. To me, the Living Flame... Ah, perhaps I... And Choen...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Koa, you were used. She must be the one responsible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What? What happened?)

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: I am Agasura, and so is Choen...

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Enough. Priestess of Water, what do you want?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Nothing in particular. I only wish to avoid needless conflict... As the Priestess of Fire, you should understand.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
