lines.text: Think about whether the Sea Dragon King has ever taken a life carelessly.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Very well. I will withdraw this time.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: But cross me even slightly, and I will not stand idle. I will cover this place and all of Jiendia in my flames!
(Koa turns away, and searing flames rise around her. They engulf her, then vanish without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Fortunately, she seems to have understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So Choen Palm is an Agasura? And she stirred up Koa, the Priestess of Fire... Why?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I cannot say for certain... But she is undoubtedly plotting something.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: At least Koa did not reveal her true Agasura form.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: If the Kukuri tribe who follow her were harmed, another fierce battle like the one just now would be unavoidable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm seems to be different.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Considering that she deceived her own kind and tried to render the Sea Dragon King powerless...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I cannot be certain, but perhaps you will find the answer when you find Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: We have no more business here. Shall we go outside? Ban will be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right...

steps.name: To Orca Beach
steps.objective: Continue talking with [Gatia Su] and [Ban Giu] in front of the "Heart of Kthuka" entrance.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Oh, is it all over?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Yes, more or less...
(Gatia Su briefly explains to Ban that the situation has been resolved.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Good work, %s...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: %s, thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. I should head back and let Master Sunsung know.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: No need. I'll go see Master Sunsung. You can continue on your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Yes, please do. There's no need to trouble yourself with another trip back.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Your help was for everyone's sake, so I grant you permission to visit Atlantis.
(A blue light appears at Gatia's fingertips, surrounds %s's body, then fades.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: When you reach Atlantis, visit Mayor Anastasia. Tell her I sent you, and she should offer you some assistance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Which way is Atlantis?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: There's a submersible at Orca Beach. Take that. Mayor Anastasia is near the building you see as soon as you arrive in Atlantis. And...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I pray that you will find Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I certainly will. Finding Iris is the reason for my journey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you again someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shall I head to Orca Beach now...?)
(After seeing %s off, Ban Giu and Gatia Su meet each other's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Gatia.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Yes, Ban?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Do you think %s can find Iris? Everyone came back except her, and no matter how hard we searched, we couldn't find her...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I don't know. But somehow, I feel Iris may be waiting at the end of that person's path.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Where will you go now, Ban?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Me? I'll... Well, somewhere I can make a little money, like before.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I'm going back to the Sea Dragon King's dwelling now. So...

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You may visit from time to time, if you think of me.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Oh... Really?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I'll be going now. Until we meet again.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Yahoo!!

steps.name: Xenadia, the Ancient Garden
steps.objective: 1. Approach the suspicious stone tower on "Orca Beach".\n2. Find and talk to "Sister Maris" and "Berkut" in the "Xenadia Surface Garden".\n3. Defeat the [Escaped Hyunmu] somewhere in the "Submerged Garden" and obtain the <Sacred Fragment>. Then go to [Sister Maris].

lines.text: (Beyond the beautiful beach, strange structures stretch high into the sky, creating a majestic sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a beautiful beach... But what's that? Some sort of ruin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never heard of anything like this being here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's beautiful...
(As %s gazes at the ruins across the sea, a voice reaches their ears.)
At last...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is that coming from? That stone tower?
(A glowing stone tower on a small rise above the beach is vibrating.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The stone tower is drawing me toward it.)
This day has come...
(A girl's hazy figure flickers in and out of sight. She seems to be saying something, but I cannot hear it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were you speaking to me?
(The girl nods, then looks toward the ruins across the sea. A moment later, she disappears from sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go to Atlantis...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But I can't stop thinking about that girl...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I get to those ruins?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The stone tower?
(The stone tower hums and begins vibrating again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems to want me to touch it...
(To enter Xenadia, use the Travel menu at the stone tower.)
(The ruins are filled with a mysterious air, but all the monsters and tangled paths make them feel like a maze.)
(Two people can be seen talking in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask them. Maybe they know this place.

lines.speaker: 어떤 엔지니어
lines.text: With my strength, even dealing with a few monsters is difficult.

lines.speaker: 어떤 시스터
lines.text: Not at all, Berkut. You've been a great help.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Then I'll rest a little and keep trying. If it proves impossible, I'll gather some people from the Steel City next time, Sister Maris.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Thank you. Um, did you invite that person, Berkut?

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I didn't invite anyone. Who?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: That person over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello...? Sorry to interrupt.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I expected adventurers to come eventually, but how did you get here? And who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm %s... I'm traveling in search of Iris. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain to Berkut and Sister Maris how my search for Iris began and how I came to be here.)

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Amazing, isn't it? Think of that stone tower as a kind of transportation device. You're looking for Iris? Well, nice to meet you. I should have introduced myself sooner.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I'm Berkut, an engineer from the Steel City... Or a Meister, as people call me. This is Sister Maris. Say hello.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where are we?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: The ancient garden of Xenadia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So these are ancient ruins?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I'll explain. The sister needs a little rest... Yes, Xenadia is an ancient ruin. It appeared off Orca Beach like this not long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that possible?

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I didn't believe it at first either. My teacher, Icarus, made such a fuss after spotting it on a walk along the beach.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: He said he was going to explore it, then I stopped hearing from him. So I came here, and sure enough, there were ancient ruins.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I found a way inside and discovered the sisters struggling with machines my teacher had made.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I don't know what he built, but where did he disappear to, leaving those uncontrollable heaps of machinery behind? The man's so irresponsible. Sigh.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: And now I'm stuck dealing with it. What was he doing in a sacred place like this...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Oh, Sister, you seem to have something you want to say...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Your name is %s, correct? You said you were looking for someone called Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Somehow, I feel I can tell you this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it about Iris?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: No. It concerns our mistress, 'Seres.'

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Sister Maris, sorry, but could you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: If you ask it, Berkut, gladly...

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: %s, was it? First, I'd like us to clear away the creatures blocking the path ahead. Will you help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'll help.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: (As I thought, this person is...)

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: You're skilled. We finished more easily than I expected.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I've brought something to drink.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Please tell me what you were going to say.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Don't be too surprised.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Apart from Berkut, the priests and sisters here are all Pluton Dragons who serve Seres, the goddess and mistress of this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The moment I hear that, I spit out the water in my mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! I'm sorry. Pluton Dragons? But you look human...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: The Pluton Dragons are a race of dragons created by Lady Seres's will.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: During the decisive battle against the Demon King Beast... at the moment Lady Seres was defeated and returned to the realm of chaos...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Our space and time stopped. Or, more precisely, froze solid. Trapped in a space of oblivion, we spent an eternity there.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Someone spoke to us occasionally, but I do not know who it was.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then... does that mean you...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I am older than you might think...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, that's not what I meant. I wondered whether you knew why you came back.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I don't know that much. When we returned to Jiendia, a great deal of time had passed.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: We wondered whether Lady Seres had returned, but she had not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Still, there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: That is why we are searching. We must adapt to this age and prepare for the day Lady Seres comes to us.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Come now. Keep your spirits up.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Adventurer... Are you perhaps one of the Tyr?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm just an ordinary person. I do know of the Tyr, though...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Long ago, adventurers from Beloras loved Xenadia and came here often. The Tyr did as well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Was Beloras the old name for Belos?)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: What will you do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I've come here, I'd like to explore a little more.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: It's larger than you might expect, so you may lose your way. But please take your time looking around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can help with?

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Should I call you kindhearted, or just unable to mind your own business? I'm going to see what else my teacher left behind. Take care.
(Berkut heads off somewhere with practiced steps.)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Then, adventurer, in honor of the courage and goodwill that brought you here, I will ask a small favor.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Since Xenadia reappeared, a profane [monster] has been seeking this place's power.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: We do not know where it is at present and are searching ourselves. If you see it, please defeat it as you did the creatures earlier.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: And please bring me the [Sacred Fragment] that it leaves behind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean...?
(The moment Sister Maris closes her eyes, the world fills with brilliant light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it's so bright...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like warmth is filling my heart...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I...?
(A tree shining with a sacred glow sways in the wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're...
(A girl's hazy figure appears. Her expression suggests she has something to say.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you... want to talk? All right. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: At last... This day has come.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I've waited for you for so long.
(The girl's faint outline gradually grows clearer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's as though you're right in front of me... But what do you mean? You've waited a long time...?
(The girl smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It was hard coming all this way, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel something in that smile... This is... like the feeling I had when I heard the name Iris...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been very lonely?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Oh...
(Tears gather in the girl's eyes, then begin to fall.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Did you know? Who I am?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No... You just felt familiar, like someone I'd known before. When you said you'd waited a long time, I suddenly felt something...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Loneliness. I wondered how lonely you must have been...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I see... Just as I'd expect of the child Iris brought here by opening the path of dreams...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Iris?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Iris... No, the Tyr are beings I shaped myself.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: This land I cherish so dearly, and the children born upon it from seeds of light containing my soul... Though I can never see them again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then... are you...?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Iris... That little child alone still lives on, bravely doing all she can.
(The girl wipes away her tears and forces a smile.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Iris, my precious child Iris... The pain she suffers now is my fault...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: P-please don't think that. Iris... Iris will get back on her feet and smile again. I'll find her and see for myself.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: What speaks to you now is an echo of Xenadia. Now that I've met you, I'll fade away. But before that, I have something to give you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess... Goddess Seres...

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Yes. My name is Seres.

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: In the age when the first starlight fell upon Orca Beach, I sowed the seeds of life and song.

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: My existence is fleeting and frail. Though I fade as a fragment of this age...

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: As I left the Tyr for the sake of the world, I now leave all the power that remains here to this young adventurer.

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Let all life in Jiendia remember: here, Seres, mistress of the moon, flowers, and growing things, blessed this adventurer's path...
(Seres reaches toward the adventurer. Light flows from the luminous tree and wraps around them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Seres...

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Please take care of Iris...

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: That child deserves happiness...
(Seres's echo grows fainter. She looks as though she could vanish at any moment.)

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: We will meet again...

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Until the day when all become one...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Seres... Lady Seres!!
(Seres can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Where on earth are you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Seres...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meeting Lady Seres couldn't have been a coincidence, could it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find Iris and tell her what you wished, Lady Seres...
(The tree shining with a sacred glow sways in the wind once more.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so warm. So peaceful...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Are you all right? You lost consciousness and gave me quite a fright.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is... Sister, I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I'm glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Sister...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain that I saw Lady Seres's echo.)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I suspected as much...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you were searching for traces of Lady Seres... How did you know to send me there?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I did no such thing. Lady Seres guided you herself. Perhaps it was her you saw and followed, rather than me.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: If the Iris you seek is the sole descendant of the Tyr... then all of this is a bond Lady Seres has given you...

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Surely it means she has faith in you.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I can feel Lady Seres's blessing. Thank you, adventurer... It has been so long since I felt this aura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't done anything.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: We will continue rebuilding this place, spreading Lady Seres's message, and considering how we may help Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Yes. May your path be filled with Lady Seres's blessings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (To reach Atlantis... I was told to take the submersible at Orca Beach, right?)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Lady Seres... The world you loved is still so beautiful. And yet...
